case_title: Alber Oraon v. State of Jharkhand
neutral_facts: The accused was assigned the construction of a house by the deceased woman. During the construction, the accused and the deceased developed intimacy, and the accused started living with her, portraying himself as her husband. The informant and his aunt were regular visitors to the deceased's house. On one visit, the informant learned from the neighborhood that only the accused was seen in the house. When they visited, the accused provided inconsistent information about the deceased and her children. The informant reported the matter to the police. During the investigation, highly decomposed bodies of a woman and two children were discovered and exhumed from a soak pit next to the toilet of the deceased's house. The trial court found the accused guilty under Sections 302 and 201 of the IPC and passed a death sentence. The High Court confirmed the conviction and death sentence.
